reason: A plugin ecosystem audit tool that collects GitHub and npm metadata, statically scans plugin sources, scores plugin health, and presents audit reports and rankings.

summaries.zh: 用于同步并分析插件目录，结合 GitHub、npm 和静态扫描结果评估插件健康度并展示排名。
summaries.en: Audits a plugin catalog by combining GitHub and npm metadata with static scans to score plugin health and display rankings.

capabilities: Synchronizes GitHub repositories by topic into a local catalog
Queries npm package metadata and weekly download information
Performs static scans of plugin metadata, scripts, and entry sources for security findings
Scores and ranks plugins using maintenance, documentation, npm, ecosystem, and security signals
Stores catalog, metadata, and history files locally
Provides leaderboard and audit tools in the web UI
